paris-le-de-france-escapes-vexin-limesto.story: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike. Out of Mitry-Mory and back again: 336 km, roughly 7 h in the saddle. sections.advice: Treat Food stop in Septeuil → Photo stop near Étréchy as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
Photo stop near Étréchy → Fresnes is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Use High point near Ozouer-le-Voulgis → Scenic stretch near Bussy-Saint-Georges as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: Dushanzi → Hashilegen Pass climbs about 3400 m in 130 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Hashilegen Pass → Nalati drops about 3400 m over 50 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Nalati → Bayinbuluke is 58 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Bayinbuluke → Kuqa is 219 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Dushanzi → Hashilegen Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 226 km. 3400 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Hashilegen Pass → Nalati
scenicChapters.narrative: 3400 m come off over 88 km at around 6.7%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

duku-highway.story: 795 km from Dushanzi to Kuqa, about 10 h 47 of riding. It goes by way of Hashilegen Pass, Nalati and Bayinbuluke. The highest point is about 3,400 m. Hashilegen Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

Raigad → Pratapgad is 45 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Pratapgad → Suvarnadurg is 67 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Suvarnadurg → back through Pratapgad is 67 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
back through Pratapgad → back through Raigad is 45 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through Raigad → Lohagad is 66 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

places-lohagad-suvarnadurg-2.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-lohagad-suvarnadurg-2.story: 386 km from Lonavla to Lonavla, about 6 h 39 of riding. It goes by way of Raigad, Pratapgad, Suvarnadurg and back through Pratapgad. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
